THE TIMES OF INDIA  City  Pune  News
'Digital arrest' scam: Pune techie loses Rs 1.2 crore to fake CBI officers
TNN / Updated: Sep 27, 2026, 22:14 IST
PUNE: A 34-year-old software engineer was duped of Rs 1.2 crore by fraudsters who posed as
CBI and customs officials and kept him under a so-called digital arrest for three days, police said.
According to police, the scammers told the victim that an arrest warrant had been issued in his name
and that his bank account would be frozen. They threatened legal action and an FIR unless he
transferred money to a "safe account" for verification. They also told him not to tell anyone.
The cyber crime cell said such calls are fake. Real agencies never conduct a digital arrest over video call.
How to stay safe: never share OTP, never install AnyDesk on a stranger's request, report at 1930.
